-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies HubSpot OAuth credentials and connectivity.

search.name: search
search.description: Search across HubSpot CRM objects (contacts, companies, deals) using the v3 search API. Returns curated results. Params: query, objectType, limit?, after?, sorts?, filters?

params.objectType: Object type to search: contacts, companies, or deals.
params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

create-contact.name: create-contact
create-contact.description: Create a new HubSpot contact. Returns curated contact shape. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: email, firstName?, lastName?, phone?, company?, jobTitle?, website?, lifecycleStage?, properties?

params.lifecycleStage: Lifecycle stage: subscriber, lead, marketingqualifiedlead, salesqualifiedlead, opportunity, customer, evangelist, other.
params.properties: Additional HubSpot contact properties as key-value pairs.

get-contact.name: get-contact
get-contact.description: Retrieve a HubSpot contact by ID or email. Returns curated { id, email, firstName, lastName, phone, company, jobTitle, website, lifecycleStage, leadStatus, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: contactId, idProperty?

params.contactId: Contact ID (HubSpot ID) or email if idProperty=email.
params.idProperty: Identifier type: "email" to lookup by email address. Default uses HubSpot ID.

list-contacts.name: list-contacts
list-contacts.description: List HubSpot contacts with optional filters. Returns curated rows { id, email, firstName, lastName, phone, company, jobTitle, lifecycleStage, createdAt }. Params: limit (1-100, def 50), after, properties?

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

update-contact.name: update-contact
update-contact.description: Update an existing HubSpot contact. Idempotent per-field — safe to retry. Params: contactId, email?, firstName?, lastName?, phone?, company?, jobTitle?, website?, lifecycleStage?, properties?

params.properties: Additional HubSpot contact properties as key-value pairs.

delete-contact.name: delete-contact
delete-contact.description: Archive (soft delete) a HubSpot contact. Irreversible via API. Returns { success, contactId }.

create-company.name: create-company
create-company.description: Create a new HubSpot company. Returns curated company shape. Not retryable. Params: name, domain?, industry?, type?, phone?, website?, city?, state?, country?, numberOfEmployees?, annualRevenue?, lifecycleStage?, properties?

params.name: Company name (required).
params.properties: Additional HubSpot company properties as key-value pairs.

get-company.name: get-company
get-company.description: Retrieve a HubSpot company by ID or domain. Returns curated { id, name, domain, industry, type, phone, website, city, state, country, numberOfEmployees, annualRevenue, lifecycleStage, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: companyId, idProperty?

params.companyId: Company ID (HubSpot ID) or domain if idProperty=domain.
params.idProperty: Identifier type: "domain" to lookup by domain name. Default uses HubSpot ID.

list-companies.name: list-companies
list-companies.description: List HubSpot companies with optional filters. Returns curated rows { id, name, domain, industry, type, phone, city, state, country, numberOfEmployees, lifecycleStage, createdAt }. Params: limit (1-100, def 50), after, properties?

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

update-company.name: update-company
update-company.description: Update an existing HubSpot company. Idempotent per-field — safe to retry. Params: companyId, name?, domain?, industry?, type?, phone?, website?, city?, state?, country?, numberOfEmployees?, annualRevenue?, lifecycleStage?, properties?

params.name: Company name.
params.properties: Additional HubSpot company properties as key-value pairs.

delete-company.name: delete-company
delete-company.description: Archive (soft delete) a HubSpot company. Irreversible via API. Returns { success, companyId }.

create-deal.name: create-deal
create-deal.description: Create a new HubSpot deal. Returns curated deal shape. Not retryable. Params: name, amount?, stage?, pipeline?, type?, closeDate?, probability?, description?, properties?

params.name: Deal name (required).
params.properties: Additional HubSpot deal properties as key-value pairs.

get-deal.name: get-deal
get-deal.description: Retrieve a HubSpot deal by ID. Returns curated { id, name, amount, stage, pipeline, type, closeDate, probability, description, source, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: dealId

list-deals.name: list-deals
list-deals.description: List HubSpot deals with optional filters. Returns curated rows { id, name, amount, stage, pipeline, type, closeDate, probability, description, createdAt }. Params: limit (1-100, def 50), after, properties?

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

update-deal.name: update-deal
update-deal.description: Update an existing HubSpot deal. Idempotent per-field — safe to retry. Params: dealId, name?, amount?, stage?, pipeline?, type?, closeDate?, probability?, description?, properties?

params.name: Deal name.
params.properties: Additional HubSpot deal properties as key-value pairs.

delete-deal.name: delete-deal
delete-deal.description: Archive (soft delete) a HubSpot deal. Irreversible via API. Returns { success, dealId }.

create-ticket.name: create-ticket
create-ticket.description: Create a new HubSpot ticket. Returns curated ticket shape. Not retryable. Params: subject, content?, status?, priority?, category?, pipeline?, stage?, source?, properties?

params.subject: Ticket subject (required).
params.properties: Additional HubSpot ticket properties as key-value pairs.

get-ticket.name: get-ticket
get-ticket.description: Retrieve a HubSpot ticket by ID. Returns curated { id, subject, content, status, priority, category, pipeline, stage, source, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: ticketId

list-tickets.name: list-tickets
list-tickets.description: List HubSpot tickets with optional filters. Returns curated rows { id, subject, content, status, priority, category, pipeline, createdAt }. Params: limit (1-100, def 50), after, properties?

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

update-ticket.name: update-ticket
update-ticket.description: Update an existing HubSpot ticket. Idempotent per-field — safe to retry. Params: ticketId, subject?, content?, status?, priority?, category?, pipeline?, stage?, source?, properties?

params.subject: Ticket subject.
params.properties: Additional HubSpot ticket properties as key-value pairs.

delete-ticket.name: delete-ticket
delete-ticket.description: Archive (soft delete) a HubSpot ticket. Irreversible via API. Returns { success, ticketId }.

create-association.name: create-association
create-association.description: Create an association between two HubSpot CRM objects (e.g., contact-company, deal-contact). Uses v4 associations API. Params: fromObjectType, fromObjectId, toObjectType, toObjectId, associationType?

params.fromObjectType: Source object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets.
params.toObjectType: Target object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets.
params.associationType: Association type ID or label (e.g., "contact_to_company", "deal_to_contact"). Optional — HubSpot will use default if omitted.

delete-association.name: delete-association
delete-association.description: Delete an association between two HubSpot CRM objects. Params: fromObjectType, fromObjectId, toObjectType, toObjectId, associationType?

list-associations.name: list-associations
list-associations.description: List all associations for a HubSpot object. Params: objectType, objectId, toObjectType, limit?

list-pipelines.name: list-pipelines
list-pipelines.description: List HubSpot pipelines for deals or tickets. Returns pipeline definitions with stages. Params: objectType (deals or tickets), includeInactive?

get-pipeline.name: get-pipeline
get-pipeline.description: Get a specific HubSpot pipeline by ID. Returns pipeline with stages. Params: objectType, pipelineId

create-engagement.name: create-engagement
create-engagement.description: Create a HubSpot engagement (call, email, meeting, note, task). Uses the v3 engagements API. Params: type (call|email|meeting|note|task), subject?, body?, status?, direction?, startTime?, duration?, associatedObjectType?, associatedObjectId?, properties?

params.subject: Subject or title of the engagement.
params.associatedObjectType: Associated object type: contacts, companies, deals, tickets.
params.associatedObjectId: HubSpot ID of the associated object.
params.properties: Additional engagement properties as key-value pairs.

get-engagement.name: get-engagement
get-engagement.description: Retrieve a HubSpot engagement by ID. Params: type (call|email|meeting|note|task), engagementId

list-engagements.name: list-engagements
list-engagements.description: List HubSpot engagements (calls, emails, meetings, notes, tasks). Params: type (call|email|meeting|note|task), limit?, after?

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

delete-engagement.name: delete-engagement
delete-engagement.description: Archive (soft delete) a HubSpot engagement. Params: type (call|email|meeting|note|task), engagementId

list-lists.name: list-lists
list-lists.description: List HubSpot lists (CRM Lists v3). Returns curated rows { id, name, processingType, dynamic, objectTypeId, createdAt, updatedAt, memberCount }. Params: limit?, offset?, processingType?

get-list.name: get-list
get-list.description: Get a specific HubSpot list by ID (CRM Lists v3). Params: listId

list-conversations.name: list-conversations
list-conversations.description: List HubSpot conversations (inbox) with optional filters. Returns curated rows. Params: limit?, after?, status?

params.status: Filter by status: OPEN, CLOSED, WAITING.

get-conversation.name: get-conversation
get-conversation.description: Get a HubSpot conversation by ID, including messages. Params: conversationId, includeMessages?

params.includeMessages: Include messages in the response. Default true.

send-conversation-message.name: send-conversation-message
send-conversation-message.description: Send a message in a HubSpot conversation (inbox reply). Params: conversationId, text, channelId?

name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot CRM integration - manage contacts, companies, deals, tickets, engagements, lists, and conversations via HubSpot REST API v3 with OAuth2

changelog.notes: Initial release — manage HubSpot contacts, companies, deals, tickets, activities, lists, conversations and webhooks straight from your agents
